title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
My client is seeking an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Administrator to join their finance team in Birkenhead.The role will focus on processing supplier invoices and payments, assisting with credit card reconciliations and providing general administrative support, including vehicle administration.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Finance
- Process incoming supplier invoices, checking details against purchase orders and ensuring the correct references and cost codes are recorded.
- Obtain the necessary authorisations and process approved invoices through the relevant finance systems.
- Prepare and process weekly supplier payment runs.
- Respond to supplier queries professionally and promptly.
- Assist with credit card transaction processing and reconciliations.
- Provide general finance and administrative support as required.
- General Administration and Operational Support
- Answer incoming telephone calls and direct enquiries appropriately.
- Liaise with drivers and vehicle maintenance providers to arrange servicing and maintenance.
- Update vehicle insurance details when vehicles are exchanged.
- Check and process driver mileage claims.
- Maintain accurate records and up-to-date documentation.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- GCSEs or equivalent, including English and Maths at grade C/4 or above.
- At least three years' experience in an accounts payable role.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience using finance systems and processing supplier invoices.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and helpful approach when dealing with colleagues, suppliers and external contacts.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

This role offers a basic salary of up to £29,000 depending on experience, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, company pension, death in service

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Salary: Circa £28,000 FTE

Permanent Full-time or potentially part-time

Experienced in Credit Control? Looking for a fresh opportunity?

Hoot Recruit is recruiting on behalf of an established business looking for a Credit Controller to join its finance team.

We're looking for someone who knows their way around credit control, enjoys dealing with customers and is confident chasing payments while maintaining good working relationships.

You'll be joining an experienced team, working alongside an existing Credit Controller who will be on hand to provide guidance and support as they move into another position within the business.

What you'll be doing
- Managing outstanding customer payments
- Contacting customers by phone and email to chase overdue invoices
- Maintaining accurate records of payments and outstanding balances
- Resolving invoice and payment queries
- Building positive relationships with customers
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Working closely with the wider finance team to keep debtor balances under control

What we're looking for
- Previous credit control experience is essential
- Confident and professional telephone manner
- Comfortable having conversations about overdue payments
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Friendly, approachable and proactive attitude

What's on offer?
- Salary circa £28,000 (pro rata for part-time)
- Permanent opportunity
- Potential flexibility around working hours
- Part-time hours may be considered, ideally spread across five days
- Support from an experienced finance team
- Stable, established business

This could be a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who wants a role where they can make a real contribution without necessarily having to manage a team.

title: Court of Protection Administrator
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Court of Protection Administrator to join a law firm in Wirral, Merseyside. This is a full-time, permanent job offering a salary of up to £24,500 per annum, with an increase planned for April 2027 in line with the Voluntary Living Wage. The vacancy has arisen following internal progression and offers the opportunity to support a specialist legal team with deputyship accounts, administration and Personal Injury Trust matters. In addition, the benefits include hybrid working following probation reviews, Medicash, Perkbox, free parking, 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a Christmas shutdown.Role Responsibilities

You will provide accurate and efficient administrative support to the Court of Protection and Deputyship team, working closely with colleagues and reporting to the Team Leader. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Entering and retrieving information using the firm's IT and case management systems.
- Processing approved payments from deputyship and designated client accounts on the instructions of the relevant File Handler.
- Carrying out monthly reconciliations of deputyship and designated client accounts.
- Providing administrative assistance with a caseload of execution-only Personal Injury Trusts.
- Opening and closing files, assisting with billing, scanning, filing and preparing outgoing post.
- Maintaining and updating Excel spreadsheets and other records accurately.
- Providing administrative support and cover to colleagues as directed by the Team Leader.

About You

This Court of Protection Administrator position would suit an organised, numerate and detail-focused person who enjoys being part of a team and handling confidential information carefully. You should be able to demonstrate the following:
- Good written and verbal communication skills and a professional, empathetic approach to clients.
- Strong numerical ability, attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
- Confidence using Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel.
- Organisational and file management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and use your own initiative.
- Experience communicating with clients by telephone and face to face.
- A reliable, discreet, flexible and client-focused approach.
- Previous office administration experience and familiarity with electronic case management systems would be advantageous.

Salary and Benefits

The firm offers a practical benefits package alongside the opportunity to work within a specialist Court of Protection team. The successful Court of Protection Administrative Assistant will benefit from:
- Salary of up to £24,500 per annum, with an increase planned for April 2027 in line with the Voluntary Living Wage.
- Permanent, full-time employment, working 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a Christmas shutdown, with the annual leave allowance increasing to 21 days in January 2027.
- Hybrid working following probation reviews.
- Medicash healthcare cash plan and Perkbox employee benefits.
- Free car parking and a relaxed dress code.
- Weekly fruit basket and monthly breakfast.
- Workplace pension following three months' employment.

About the Law Firm

Our client is a Lexcel-accredited law firm providing Court of Protection, conveyancing and private client services. Its dedicated Deputyship team works with individuals, families and other professionals, with an emphasis on clear communication and client care. This opportunity has become available through internal progression, and the firm also highlights ongoing staff training and development.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Court of Protection Administrative Assistant job in Wirral, Merseyside, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

title: Document Controller / Project Administrator
description:
Document Controller / Project Administrator

Prenton Hybrid Permanent/ Fixed Term ASAP Start

Walker Sime is looking for a Document Controller / Project Administrator to join our team in Prenton, supporting the delivery of a major infrastructure programme.

This is a broader role combining document control, project administration and coordination, including supporting the administration of NEC contracts.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a structured project environment, is comfortable managing detailed information and documentation, and can work confidently with different stakeholders.

About Walker Sime

Walker Sime is a UK-based construction consultancy providing project management, quantity surveying and commercial management services across a range of sectors.

As part of HanmiGlobal, we combine the feel and relationships of a UK consultancy with the scale, expertise and opportunities of a global project management business.

The Role

You'll provide document control and administrative support to the project team while also helping coordinate customer applications and associated works.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing and maintaining controlled project documentation
- Supporting the administration of NEC contracts and associated records
- Maintaining document registers, trackers and project information
- Uploading, reviewing, distributing and filing documentation through the appropriate systems
- Supporting the coordination and progression of customer applications
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Monitoring actions and following up on outstanding information
- Ensuring documentation remains accurate, current and appropriately controlled
- Providing wider project administration and coordination support to the team

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Previous document control or project administration experience
- Experience working within a project or programme environment
- Strong document management and administration skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong organisation and coordination skills
- Confidence working with multiple stakeholders
- Experience supporting NEC4 contracts would be advantageous
- Previous experience with Autodesk document management systems would be beneficial
- Experience within infrastructure, utilities or construction would be useful, but isn't essential

Working Pattern

This is a hybrid role, with 2 days per week based in our Prenton office and 3 days working from home. For your first two weeks, you'll be based in Prenton full-time while completing your training.

We're looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

Apply now or get in touch.

Please note, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK.
